Why professionals choose Bloom

Built for professionals who take their careers seriously.

Bloom brings the same rigour recruiters and career coaches use, distilled into a calm, guided experience you can trust with your next move.

Grounded in real hiring data

Every recommendation is shaped by how resumes and profiles actually perform with recruiters and applicant tracking systems.

Private by design

Your resume and profile details are used to help you, and only you. Nothing is shared without your permission.

Guidance, not guesswork

Clear, specific suggestions replace vague advice, so every change you make has a reason behind it.

How it works

Three steps. Clear guidance the whole way.

No lengthy setup, no guesswork. Bloom gets to work the moment you share where you stand today.

Upload your resume

Share your current resume so Bloom can assess formatting, structure and ATS readability in seconds.

Connect your LinkedIn

Add your profile link so Bloom can review your headline, summary and positioning for the roles you want.

Receive personalised insights

Get a clear plan covering resume edits, profile improvements and roles worth pursuing next.

What Bloom does

Everything your job search needs, in one place.

From the first draft of your resume to the offer letter, Bloom stays with you at every stage.

Resume Analysis

Line-by-line feedback on structure, clarity and impact, benchmarked against roles like yours.

LinkedIn Optimisation

Sharper headlines and summaries that reflect how recruiters actually search and skim profiles.

Career Recommendations

Personalised direction on roles, industries and skills worth pursuing based on your background.

Smart Job Matching

Opportunities filtered by fit, not just keywords, so every application is worth your time.

Interview Preparation

Tailored talking points and practice questions drawn from your resume and the role itself.

Application Tracking

One clear view of every application, follow-up and next step, so nothing slips through.
